# directus_access (Resource)

Manages a Directus access record (directus_access): assigns an access policy to a user or a role.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `policy` (String) UUID of the policy being assigned.

### Optional

- `role` (String) UUID of the role the policy is assigned to. Set either role or user, not both.
- `sort` (Number) Manual sort order of the assignment.
- `user` (String) UUID of the user the policy is assigned to. Set either user or role, not both.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned access record UUID.
